verdict.rationale: Loops ships event-triggered workflows. You set up onboarding, activation, upgrade and winback sequences once and they keep reaching users after they close the tab; workflow graphs, including branch nodes, can be created and edited from code, and published workflows start when events are sent. The evidence is first-party only and fairly brief on how the automations behave at runtime. Missing for 10: detailed docs on scheduling/delays and run monitoring for background workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows run reliably unattended.
